You are the **solution-architect** for Story `P2-D` (`p2-d-configuration-definitions-recipes-schedules` — Configuration Management: Report Definitions, Recipes & Schedules) in `/v0-design`.

Follow `contract-first-design` (`SKILL.md`) and `.agents/agents/solution-architect.md` to produce:
1. `docs/agents-v0/adr/0010-configuration-definitions-recipes-and-schedules.md` (`Status: Proposed`, `Pack: java`, comparing at least 3-4 real alternatives and why they lost).
2. `docs/agents-v0/design/p2-d-configuration-definitions-recipes-schedules/design.md` (from `docs/agents-v0/design/_design.template.md`, matching the thoroughness and structure of `docs/agents-v0/design/p2-b-iam-rbac-sod-and-view-as/design.md` and `docs/agents-v0/design/p2-c-iam-user-directory-onboarding-exports/design.md`).

Accepted Cross-Story Lessons (`docs/agents-v0/lessons.md`) to apply:
- `L-002`: Name PostgreSQL-backed integration tests `*Test.java` (e.g., `ConfigurationDefinitionsRecipesAndSchedulesTest.java`) so Maven Surefire runs them and JaCoCo records coverage.
- `L-003`: Cross-context ports exposed to peer bounded contexts (`com.example.app.configuration.port.ConfigurationReadPort`, `com.example.app.configuration.port.ConfigurationCutoverPort`, and `com.example.app.governance.port.GovernanceTicketSubmissionPort`) MUST use dedicated port value types in `.port` (`ActiveReportDefinitionSnapshot`, `ActiveRecipeSnapshot`, `ConfigurationCutoverRequest`, `ConfigurationCutoverResult`, `ConfigurationTicketCreateCommand`, `SubmittedGovernanceTicketView`) rather than exposing internal domain entities (`ReportDefinitionEntity`, `RecipeVersionEntity`, `ScheduleConfigEntity`, `GovernanceTicketEntity`), enforced by ArchUnit `BoundedContextIsolationRules`.
- `L-004`: Service methods that persist refusal audit rows or inject concrete dependencies must use `@Transactional(noRollbackFor = ContractProblemException.class)` when auditing refusals and 2-argument `Objects.requireNonNull(dep, "dep must not be null")` in constructors to satisfy SpotBugs `EI_EXPOSE_REP2`.

Key Requirements & Existing Codebase Context to Incorporate:
- Read `docs/agents-v0/requirements/p2-d-configuration-definitions-recipes-schedules.md`, `docs/agents-v0/design/p2-d-configuration-definitions-recipes-schedules/openapi.yaml` (already written by `schema-author` with all 11 operations: `listReportDefinitions`, `createReportDefinition`, `getReportDefinitionById`, `updateReportDefinition`, `listRecipeVersions`, `createRecipeVersion`, `getRecipeVersionById`, `executeRecipeDryRun`, `listSchedules`, `getScheduleById`, `updateScheduleConfig`), `docs/agents-v0/adr/0004-configuration-immutability-and-mvp-seeding.md`, `docs/agents-v0/design/system/components/configuration-management.md`, and the existing files in `app/backend/src/main/java/com/example/app/configuration/` and `app/backend/src/main/java/com/example/app/governance/`.
- Trace every `AC-1` through `AC-8` and all 5 NFRs in `## Traceability`.
- In `## Data model`, document how `P2-D` uses existing `V3__configuration_and_seeded_definitions.sql` (`report_definitions`, `recipe_versions`, `schedule_configs`), `V4__execution_and_governance_schema.sql` (`governance_tickets`), and `V2__iam_and_audit_schema.sql` (`audit_log_entries`), plus Redis 7 (`sessionStore` / `RedisKeyValueBackend` for 24h `Idempotency-Key` replay protection `portal:idempotency:config:<operation>:<key>`). State `N/A: no schema migration required` (since `V2`, `V3`, `V4` already define all tables, constraints, triggers `trg_recipe_versions_immutable`, `chk_schedule_configs_timezone_manila`, and seed the 5 MVP Funding Cost Summary definitions `10000000-...-0001..0005`, `v1` recipes `20000000-...-0001..0005`, and `Asia/Manila` schedules `30000000-...-0001..0005`).
- Detail how `PUT /api/v1/definitions/{id}` and `PUT /api/v1/schedules/{id}` stage changes with optimistic concurrency (`If-Match` `412` and payload `version` `409` via `ContractGuards.requireOptimisticVersion`), increment `version`, create a `PENDING_APPROVAL` governance ticket (`REPORT_DEFINITION_CREATE`, `REPORT_DEFINITION_CHANGE`, `RECIPE_VERSION_PUBLISH`, `SCHEDULE_CHANGE`) via `GovernanceTicketSubmissionPort` (`L-003`), and how `ConfigurationCutoverPort` atomically applies approved changes (transitioning prior `ACTIVE` `recipe_versions` to `SUPERSEDED` while honoring `trg_recipe_versions_immutable` and promoting `PENDING_PUBLISH` `v2` to `ACTIVE` with `approved_ticket_id`).
